name: UnverifiedContr_0x452E25
fix_description: In uniswapV3SwapCallback (0xfa461e33), no validation that msg.sender is a legitimate Uniswap V3 pool. Any caller can invoke this callback and trigger token transfers. Add pool address verification.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a multi-step AMM reserve-manipulation attack using a flash loan, a swap into the target token, repeated token transfers plus skim calls to distort pair balances, and a final swap back for profit. It requires understanding UniswapV2 pair accounting and the effect of skim on excess balances, making it more protocol-specific than a simple bug but still not deeply complex.
